note: The How to play card (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 17): every word it shows, as data, so a tone change or a translation is a data swap. Pages hold items; an item is an icon (drawn by UiHowto) and a line. Keys on the controls page come from Controls' map through ui/data/glyphs.json. The core principle in the copy: the player owns strategy, pacing and positioning; the fight director owns combos, tactics and voice lines. Keep lines short: a phone shows them at 12 dp or more.
title: HOW TO PLAY
reopen: Open this again any time from the pause menu, or press F1.

items.text: You are the strategist: where to fly, when to press or rest, and which stance to take.
The fight director plays the blows. Combos, tactics and voice follow from your stance and position.
There are no health bars. Damage shows on the bodies: bruised, battered, broken.
A fight ends with a finisher, not a clock.
Push the attack and close the gap.
Hold firm and punish the opening.
Slip away, then counter.
Break away. A gamble, not a guarantee.
Fly
Dash (hold)
Light attack
Heavy attack
Signature (needs 45 Charge)
Charge (hold)
Special (hold)
Transform (hold)
Stances
Pause
Player 2 on the same keyboard: arrows, Enter, comma, period, slash, semicolon, and 7 8 9 0 for stances.

touch_items.text: Left thumb: fly. The stick appears where you touch.
Right thumb: light and heavy attack. The signature appears when you have 45 Charge.
Left edge: hold Charge or Special. Transform appears when it is ready.
Stance ring under your nameplate: tap a stance.

items.text: A ring flashes round a fighter when a body part gets worse.
Cards name what changed, like ARMS: BROKEN.
A faint ring marks a fighter on the brink. A finisher can end the fight.
A ring closing on a fighter is a window. Press Light inside it to parry, or again to chain.
In a finisher, rings close on a target. Press on the beats to fight back.
The top chip counts what your fight costs the world.
The strip is the whole planet with both of you on it. It wraps.
